spec.claim_summary: Buy Bitcoin on a daily close above the prior 20-day high when the previous marker was at least three sessions earlier, with a stop below the signal extreme and exit within a few bars.
assumptions: Timeframe 1d chosen from daily language like next day and trading sessions; claim does not state 1d explicitly.
BTCUSDT mapped from Bitcoin (BTC) on Binance reference.
Direction interpreted as long from Buy entry; new 20-day low side not traded separately because entry is AND-only and direction is single-sided.
Gap of at least 3 sessions encoded as no 20-day-high close breakout on the prior 2 bars.
Next-bar open fill used to approximate next-day entry at the watermark.
NOT EXPRESSIBLE: exact limit entry at the previous 20-day high/low watermark and exact stop price below the signal extreme; stop approximated with an ATR multiple.
Time exit 4 bars chosen as middle of stated 2-6 interval range.

evidence.quote: OHLCV historical data for Bitcoin (BTC) from Binance exchange.

The close of the new high/low must be greater than (beyond) the previous high/low price marker.
The market makes a new 20day high or low and the previous high/low marker must have been at least 3 trading sessions prior.

audit_majors: entry: Claim requires buys on both new 20-day high AND new 20-day low triggers ('new 20day high or low', 'high/low watermark'). Spec implements only highest_high breakout (close > 20-day high) and omits the symmetric low-side buy condition (close beyond prior 20-day low). Assumption drops low side but choice contradicts explicit claim language.
